projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Explore my latest mobile & web software applications

p1.title: Smart Home System
p1.desc: A smart home application that allows users to control devices remotely through a mobile application.
p1.longDesc: An end-to-end IoT smart home solution integrating a Flutter mobile client with ESP32 microcontroller hardware and Firebase Realtime Database. Features real-time sensor status monitoring, remote relay control, automatic security alerts, and custom ambient lighting modes.

p2.title: Flutter Mobile Applications
p2.desc: Modern cross-platform mobile applications with responsive UI and smooth user experience.
p2.longDesc: A suite of modern Flutter mobile applications demonstrating clean architecture, Provider/Riverpod state management, custom animations, dark mode support, and REST API integration with Firebase backend storage.

p3.title: React.js Web Projects
p3.desc: Responsive web applications built using modern frontend technologies.
p3.longDesc: Modern React web applications developed with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, component-driven UI architecture, state management, interactive dashboards, and full responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
